mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') THEN payable_amount END), 0) AS monthReceivable, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN payable_amount END), 0) AS lastMonthReceivable, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') THEN paid_amount END), 0) AS monthReceived, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpaidCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdueCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpaidMonthCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') THEN payable_amount - IFNULL(paid_amount, 0) END), 0) AS unpaidAmount FROM bill

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dispatchCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS handlingCount FROM repair_record

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS replyCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS handlingCount FROM complaint_record

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM building) AS buildingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house) AS houseCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house WHERE status IN (2, 3)) AS occupiedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house WHERE status = 1) AS vacantCount
SELECT COUNT(*) AS residentCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS residentMonthCount FROM resident

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, IFNULL(SUM(payable_amount), 0) AS amount FROM bill WHERE create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, IFNULL(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS amount FROM bill WHERE status = 1 AND pay_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m')
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM repair_record WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY status
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM complaint_record WHERE status IN (1, 2) GROUP BY status
mapper.sql: SELECT b.bill_id, b.bill_no, b.payable_amount, b.paid_amount, b.status, b.pay_time, b.create_time, ft.fee_type_name, bd.building_name FROM bill b LEFT JOIN fee_type ft ON b.fee_type_id = ft.fee_type_id LEFT JOIN house h ON b.house_id = h.house_id LEFT JOIN building bd ON h.building_id = bd.building_id
